CITY OF ALHAMBRA DESIGN REVIEW BOARD
  MINUTES
  Regular Meeting
  July 26, 2022

•  CALL MEETING TO ORDER: 7:30 P.M. via video conference and teleconference

•  ROLL CALL:
  Present:  Ankit Udani, Michael Daninger, Nora Hernandez
  Absent:  Stanley Tsai
  Staff Present:  Richard Abe AIA, Vist Yang

ELECTION OF OFFICERS

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez nominated Udani for President.
 •  The second was by Daninger.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Udani, Daninger, Hernandez
  Noes: None
  Absent: Tsai

MOTION:
 •  Udani nominated Hernandez for Vice President.
 •  The second was by Daninger.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Udani, Daninger, Hernandez
  Noes: None
  Absent: Tsai

MOTION:
 •  Udani nominated Richard Abe for Secretary.
 •  The second was by Daninger.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Udani, Daninger, Hernandez
  Noes: None
  Absent: Tsai

CONSENT AGENDA
All items on the consent agenda will be addressed under a single motion unless a Design Review
Board Member of a member of the public requests that the item be heard under the Discussion
Agenda.

  1
 ITEM 1: DRB MINUTES - July 12, 2022

ITEM 2: 8 West Main Street
This application is new signage for an existing commercial building.

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for approval as submitted.

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to approve the consent calendar.
 •  The second was by Daninger.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes:  Udani, Daninger, Hernandez
  Noes:  None
  Absent: Tsai

DISCUSSION ITEMS:

ITEM 3: 306 Orange Grove Avenue
This application is for a new one-story addition to an existing single-family residence.

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for continuance.

ACTION MINUTES:
The applicant was present and the staff report was given. The applicant stated that much of the house
design is unchanged.

Jennifer Ng was present and stated that she was in agreement with staff comments. She also stated
that the owner may reconsider the black roof.

Daninger agreed with staff comments and also stated that he did not like the black roof.

Udani and Hernandez were also in agreement with the staff comments. Hernandez stated that the
details should be more in keeping with a specific architectural style and that the proposal was adding
and changing 3 sides of the home.

The owners stated that the house is not a craftsman and that they should not be bound to that style.

Udani stated that if craftsman is not the intended style then the detailing (like the columns at the
porch) should not lean into that stylistic detail.

Abe stated that there are errors in the drawings, there are submittal elements lacking in the proposal
(like photos of the existing house) and there are design inconsistencies. The DRB staff is willing to
assist the applicant offline.

  2
 The applicant stated that he has been in the planning process for three years and that no one ever
discussed design issues with him. Abe stated that he would check with the City but that this is the
first review of this design by DRB staff and this review body.

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to continue the application to allow redesign.
 •  The second was by Daninger.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Udani, Daninger, Hernandez
  Noes: None
  Absent: Tsai

ITEM 4: 314 South 8th Street
This application is for a new one-story addition to an existing single-family residence.

RECOMMENDED ACTION: Recommendation is for continuance.

ACTION MINUTES:
The applicant was absent.

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to continue the application due to the absence of the applicant.
 •  The second was by Daninger.
 •  The motion carried with the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Udani, Daninger, Hernandez
  Noes: None
  Absent: Tsai

ADJOURNMENT:
There being no other business, the meeting was adjourned at 8:30 P.M. to the next meeting on
August 9, 2022.

MOTION:
 •  Hernandez moved to adjourn the meeting at 8:30
 •  Seconded by Daninger
 •  The motion carried by the following roll call vote:
  Ayes: Udani, Daninger, Hernandez
  Noes: None
  Absent: Tsai

PASSED, APPROVED AND ADOPTED this 9th day of August, 2022.

  _____________________________
  Nora Hernandez, Vice Chairman
